item.title: Trump Highlights Importance of Jensen Huang to Nvidia
item.description: President Trump emphasized the value of Jensen Huang's leadership to Nvidia during discussions about corporate governance. He suggested that losing such talent poses a greater risk than current regulatory concerns.

item.title: ProShares Discusses NVDA ETF Following CEO Return
item.description: ProShares executive Inkoo Kang discussed the firm's Nvidia-linked ETFs on a recent broadcast. The conversation covered the ProShares Ultra NVDA ETF and new offerings related to Anthropic.

item.title: Trump Considers Capping Credit Card Interest Rates
item.description: President Trump expressed openness to capping credit card interest rates for consumers. However, the proposal remains in the early stages and is not guaranteed to occur.

item.title: Analysts See Jensen Huang's Return Stabilizing Nvidia Shares
item.description: Market strategists suggest the return of Jensen Huang to Nvidia may help stabilize the broader AI sector. However, concerns regarding data-center performance and capital spending persist.

item.title: Trump Administration Assures Nvidia Board on Jensen Huang
item.description: President Trump stated his administration provided assurances to Nvidia's board regarding Jensen Huang. The administration indicated that Huang would not be considered a national security threat upon his reinstatement as CEO.

item.title: Anthropic Shares Lag Despite Broader AI Sector Rebound
item.description: Anthropic shares showed little direction on Monday despite a general recovery in the AI sector. The company's performance diverged from the market trend following the return of Nvidia's CEO.

item.title: Brazilian Real Drops to 19-Month Low Following Election
item.description: The Brazilian real reached a 19-month low as market selloffs continued following the re-election of President Lula da Silva. Investors are expressing concern over the government's rising debt levels.

item.title: Tata Steel Shares Fall After Announcing $1.67 Billion Stake Acquisition
item.description: Tata Steel has arranged to acquire a 26.4% ownership interest in India's top manufacturer of structural steel pipes and tubes for $1.67 billion. Following the strategic move, the company's equity shares slid by almost 5%.

item.title: Houthis Target Saudi Oil Refinery Amid Diplomatic Uncertainty
item.description: Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis announced an operation targeting the Rabigh oil facility located in Saudi Arabia. The development comes as diplomatic attempts to resolve the regional conflict encounter challenging odds.

item.title: Indian Equities Fluctuate After Erasing Yearly Losses on Foreign Inflows
item.description: Indian equities rose early Monday to briefly recover all losses for the year before turning downward. Inflows of foreign capital and a rotation away from AI assets helped drive renewed interest in the market.

item.title: Gold Prices Rise as Investors Buy Dips Following Steep Weekly Drop
item.description: Gold climbed as buyers took advantage of price declines following its sharpest weekly fall in eight months. Market sentiment was supported by reduced expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate increase in December.

item.title: Corporate Executives Highlight Generational Growth Themes
item.description: US corporations are increasingly promoting long-term growth opportunities during their earnings conference calls. Executive discussions have frequently labeled areas such as artificial intelligence, trading cards, and airport projects as generational shifts.

item.title: Nasdaq 100 Nears Bear Market as Dip Buyers Hesitate
item.description: Investors are showing reluctance to buy the dip as the Nasdaq 100 approaches bear market territory. Despite attractive valuations, market participants remain cautious following a significant selloff.

item.title: Republican Senator Proposes Ending Social Security
item.description: A Republican senator has suggested that the Social Security program should be terminated. Projections indicate the program's trust funds may be depleted within six years.

item.title: Bond Market Fed Hike Bets Impacted by Stock Slump
item.description: Wall Street's preferred trade for betting on Federal Reserve rate hikes is facing pressure from declining equity markets. Investors are weighing the Fed's inflation-fighting stance against a darkening economic outlook.

item.title: Robot Startup Backed by Eric Trump Faces Benefit Cuts
item.description: A robot startup supported by Eric Trump has cut employee health benefits due to severe cash flow constraints. The firm is currently seeking an emergency bridge loan while awaiting a $150 million investment.

item.title: Closed-End Funds May Offer Value During Market Crashes
item.description: Investors are being encouraged to consider closed-end funds as potential low-risk opportunities during market downturns. These assets could provide value if current volatility evolves into a crash.

item.title: Private Equity Ownership Linked to Higher Hospice Costs
item.description: Research indicates that hospice centers owned by private equity firms are associated with increased Medicare spending. Patients at these facilities also tend to have longer stays.

item.title: Intelligence Director Clayton Cautions on Tech Outages
item.description: Jay Clayton issued a warning regarding potential future disruptions following recent technical failures. These incidents previously affected banking transactions, Microsoft 365, and air travel.

item.title: Compass Group Considers Moving Listing to New York
item.description: Compass Group is reportedly planning to shift its primary stock listing from London to New York. This potential move is viewed as a setback for the UK financial market.

item.title: Pizza Chains Face Declining Demand and Competition
item.description: Major pizza chains are experiencing significant pressure from shifting consumer habits and increased delivery competition. The adoption of GLP-1 medications is cited as a contributing factor to the weaker demand.

item.title: Asian Stocks Slide as AI Concerns Counter Policy Support
item.description: Equities in South Korea and China retreated as concerns surrounding the AI sector dampened investor appetite. The declines persisted despite regional official support programs and signs of stability in US equity markets.

item.title: Quantum Computing Focuses on Energy Sector Applications
item.description: Companies in the quantum computing sector are exploring early deployments in energy rather than pharmaceuticals. Experimental work includes solar material research, hydrogen catalyst design, and electrical grid optimization.

item.title: Homebuyers Gain Leverage as US Sales Drop to Record Lows Amid 7% Rates
item.description: Prospective buyers face 7% mortgage interest rates alongside historically peak property valuations. With transaction volumes slumping to unprecedented lows, the limited active buyers are exerting greater pricing power in transactions.

item.title: Anthropic debuts on Nasdaq as tech suffers worst week since 2020
item.description: Anthropic executed a record-setting initial public offering on the Nasdaq exchange. The event coincided with the tech sector's sharpest weekly retreat since 2020, occurring right before Nvidia ended its longest weekly losing stretch since 2008.

item.title: Analysts warn low valuation multiples in memory stocks signal peak pricing
item.description: Micron and Sandisk shares currently trade at compressed valuation multiples that market participants might view as attractive entry points. Analysts warn that historically, low valuation multiples in memory chip makers have signaled peak cycle pricing.

item.title: Goldman Sachs develops financing framework to fund costly AI chip purchases
item.description: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. dedicated over a year to devising strategies that fund artificial intelligence microchips. The solution is aimed at avoiding balance sheet impairment for tech corporations making heavy hardware purchases.

item.title: Technology outages heighten concerns over AI cyber risks and power grid
item.description: Recent infrastructure failures in the technology sector have prompted rising alarms over AI-enabled cyber threats and electrical network vulnerabilities. In response, business activity tied to preparedness and resilience has gained momentum.

item.title: High Gold Prices Fuel Surge in Small-Scale California Mining Operations
item.description: Elevated gold prices have triggered a renewed wave of prospecting across California. Individual miners are committing capital, time, and manual effort to extract valuable deposits.

item.title: CFTC, Congress, and states escalate clash over prediction market rules
item.description: Multiple regulatory tiers are stepping up efforts to govern prediction markets following the midterm elections. The escalating struggle involves state agencies alongside federal oversight from Congress and the CFTC.
